dict.string: Knurl plays Apple Music from the rotary dial. Closing the dial does not stop the track.
Knurl reads the current track in Music and can start one of your playlists. Play, pause, and skip still use the system media keys.
Knurl listens only while you hold Flow or ⌃⌥M, then pastes the words into the app you were in. Audio never leaves this Mac.
Knurl turns speech into text on this Mac while you hold Flow. Nothing is sent to a server.
Knurl talks to the iPhone crown on your Wi-Fi or personal hotspot. Nothing leaves the LAN.
Knurl uses your approximate location only to show local weather on the Tools page. The coordinate is rounded to about a kilometre before it leaves this Mac, and nothing else is sent.
